CORE-ONLY SOURCE PROFILE NOTICE INVENTORY

Base: visualbruno/CuMesh d10e54c30ddd03d11472c1431693f985501c7966.
This adaptation removes BVH/remeshing imports and native DC bindings. No
selected xatlas source is modified. The topology2 adaptation additionally modifies
src/simplify.cu as recorded in topology-guard.patch/build-provenance.json;
this supersedes the inherited wheel header about unchanged mesh algorithms.
No commercial legal guarantee or general platform qualification is asserted.

Included own CuMesh source uses the accompanying upstream LICENSE.
Selected xatlas sources retain the following exact upstream notices, including
Thekla/NVIDIA, Fast-BVH and OpenNL attribution. CUDA CUB templates additionally
carry the following installed-header notice; this does not replace the CUDA
Toolkit, PyTorch or toolchain's own applicable licenses.

Excluded: third_party/cubvh (including LICENSE_NVIDIA), cumesh/bvh.py,
cumesh/remeshing.py and src/remesh. They are not selected source, build inputs,
package modules or supported APIs. Their notices remain preserved in the clean
base checkout; exclusion does not relicense them.
